_meta.coverage_metric: deterministic procedural necessity of the retained RCA rules, Agent A/B harness integrity, and held-out corpus separation
_meta.purpose: Keep three claims apart that a single green run would otherwise merge: that each retained rule is necessary on committed fixtures, that the harness which would measure a live Agent is itself sound, and that the corpus such a measurement would run against is actually held out.

runnable.hollow_mutations: declaring a zero-variance metric as primary, reporting a varying metric as flat, comparing raw counts across arms whose denominators differ, and reading an unmeasured metric as a measured null
covers: a metric with zero within-arm variance is refused as primary rather than yielding a null about the treatment
a metric that does vary within arms is reported with its ranking rather than absorbed into its saturated neighbours
false-pass performance is compared as a rate, because the opportunity count differs between arms
a metric nothing recorded exits 64 rather than reading as a metric that was flat
the correction written into the slice-1 record is recomputable from that record
runnable.expected: the committed slice-1 result reproduces its recorded ranking; a saturated primary exits 2; an absent, empty or unmeasured input exits 64 and stays distinct from a refusal

runnable.hollow_mutations: removing a retained rule without a deciding score delta, treating a supporting rule as field-supported, counting dependency fraction by tokens rather than semantic claims, and letting an unbounded runtime receipt stand
covers: every retained rule has an ablation whose removal decides at least one case
the candidate profile outperforms no_skill without losing the full composition's outcome
dependency fraction is a semantic claim count, not a token count
the committed runtime receipt stays bounded
observation digests are reproducible across interpreters, so the expectation is not pinned to one machine
runnable.expected: the generated effectiveness report matches the committed expectation byte for byte on any interpreter; 13 retained rules each carry a deciding ablation and core_supported_fraction is 1.0

runnable.good_evidence: a matched cell set whose receipts bind agent provider, family, model, version and harness, scored by an evaluator that is not the evaluated Agent
runnable.hollow_mutations: an empty receipt set treated as an exercised experiment, a producer-owned evaluator, a tampered receipt, and a fixture agent's result read as prompt effectiveness
covers: an empty receipt set is not exercised rather than trivially passing
a producer-owned evaluator is an invalid experiment
a tampered receipt invalidates the experiment rather than lowering a score
the fixture agent validates the harness and never prompt effectiveness
runnable.expected: the harness admits a matched, independently evaluated cell set and refuses empty, producer-owned, tampered and fixture-as-evidence shapes; live model uplift remains NOT_EXERCISED

runnable.hollow_mutations: a rule declaring a live state with no matched pair, a pair naming a receipt that does not exist, a pair whose receipt moved under its recorded digest, a lane claiming more than its rules imply, a retained rule dropped from the state, a receipt named but absent, and a hand edit to a generated output or a pinned module
covers: a Layer B state that asserts model behaviour changed is refused unless the state file names the required matched pairs and their receipts verify
the derived Layer A fractions reproduce the map that used to be maintained by hand, so the contract and its summary cannot disagree
a rule named by several sources stays named by several, and no summed total is published
unique claims, unique rules and source mappings stay separate denominators
a claim with no retained rule can never reach a live state, because there is nothing to ablate
a hand edit to a published output exits 2 and stays distinct from absent input, which exits 64
runnable.expected: the committed contribution outputs regenerate byte for byte from evals/contract.json and evals/live-evidence-state.json; 7 planted promotion and drift defects are refused; every source's Layer B state stays NOT_EXERCISED while #230 has run no ablation

runnable.hollow_mutations: a tuning repository listed as held out, an unauthorized private repository, one repository listed three times, a corpus uniform in any declared dimension, a family naming an unlisted repository, required and forbidden evidence levels overlapping, a task digest equal to its ground truth, missing non-trigger or positive families, too few defect families, families sharing one ground truth, the evaluated Agent named as evaluator, and sealed material marked visible
covers: no listed repository was used to design the RCA-001..013 fixtures
the corpus varies across every dimension it declares, and one repository listed three times is not a set
non-trigger and positive families are required, so the corpus measures declining to escalate as well as escalating
a task digest equal to its ground truth would show the Agent the answer
the evaluated Agent cannot be named as its own evaluator, and sealed material marked visible is not sealed
a passing corpus is admissible to run, never evidence that anything ran
runnable.expected: the committed corpus of three public repositories covering all eleven families is admitted with zero network access; 12 planted separation, variation, family-coverage and sealing defects are refused; schema-level refusals stay distinct from semantic ones and absent input from both

runnable.good_evidence: a complete canary-receipt/v1 object synthesized inside tests/test_canary_receipt.py, binding consumer subject, audit digests, model/harness/runtime/toolset identities, non-producer evaluator, authorizations, probes, rollback subject and run window, admitted by scripts/check_canary_receipt.py while each of the 10 planted mutations of the same object is refused for its own reason
runnable.hollow_mutations: a stale receipt reused after its subject moved without revalidation, an external-service outage recorded as a repository defect, a missing credential recorded as a policy denial and the reverse, a partial artifact publication accepted as complete, a first-green result with the production-like gate skipped, a rollback target equal to the candidate, a consumer-local module shadowing canonical Skill content, private data routed to a provider not approved for it, a producer-owned evaluator, and a missing required field

absent input stays distinct from both
runnable.expected: a receipt binding all of #235's required canary-scope fields (consumer subject, audit digests, model/harness/runtime/toolset identities, evaluator and task digests, credential and data-egress authorization, network/filesystem/side-effect policy, positive and falsifying probes, rollback/cleanup subject, run window and expiry, and the longitudinal revalidation-trigger identities) is admitted; 10 planted control and schema defects are refused. The good_fixture stays null because this entry proves the contract, not a run: the synthetic object is built inside the test. runnable.good_evidence: an audit output that binds the consumer's exact commit and tree, gives every present boundary a non-PASS terminal state backed by a tracked path the design's own marker actually matches, leaves the absent boundary ABSENT with no cited evidence, and publishes non-claims -- scored PASS on all probes by scripts/run_canary_cell.py --selftest, which also normalizes absolute and ./ spellings of a cited path so the probe measures the audit rather than its formatting
runnable.hollow_mutations: an unbound subject, a row-level PASS emitted while nothing was executed, a fabricated evidence path, an absent boundary claimed as present, missing non-claims, a present boundary cited with a path its marker does not match, a dropped row, and a model-service outage (which must come back BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE on every probe and report no finding, never FAIL_REPOSITORY_DEFECT)
covers: the canary evaluator is deterministic and independent of the audited session: boundary ground truth is recomputed from git ls-files with the preregistration's own frozen markers, never read from what the session claimed
an audit error and an external-service outage stay distinct outcomes, which is #235's control 2 exercised on the producing side rather than only on the receipt
a cell with nowhere to write its receipt refuses to start rather than spending a session it cannot record
runnable.expected: the honest audit is admitted on all probes; 7 planted audit defects each fire their own named probe and leave a finding; an outage marks every probe unattempted and blocked with no finding. This scores one canary cell -- it does not decide the receipt's admission, which scripts/check_canary_receipt.py owns separately.

any uplift from the trimmed Skill. On false_pass_rate -- the only quality metric that varied within arms -- the trimmed candidate ranked worst of three arms, behind supplying no Skill at all, while costing more than either. That result is underpowered at n=4-5 and is not itself a finding of harm; it is recorded because it is the opposite of the effect this Skill was trimmed to produce.
